changeSet.author: fee-confirm
changeSet.comment: Old code marked a reimbursement SUCCESS the instant the node accepted the broadcast, never verifying it on-chain — so dropped reimbursements look collected but never were. Re-open every broadcast-but-unverified row to the new BROADCAST state; FeeStatusPoller reconciles each against the chain (confirmed ones return to SUCCESS, dropped ones fall to FAILED and get retried).

update.where: status = 'SUCCESS' AND tx_hash_fee IS NOT NULL
